description: WakeUp D-088 material logic categories and perspective rules

types.name: AI 单位
types.colorSpec: Coral identity accent, muted uniform materials, silver highlights.
types.description: 由 AI 控制、可参与空间与玩法交互的单位

types.name: NPC
types.colorSpec: Warm yellow identity accent, restrained clothing palette.
types.description: 叙事或服务型非玩家角色

types.name: 载具
types.colorSpec: Blue-gray body with restrained cyan technical highlights.
types.description: 可承载角色或物品的载具

types.name: 容器
types.colorSpec: Muted brown or gray body, clear opening and storage affordance.
types.description: 以承载或收纳关系为主要能力的素材

types.name: 物品
types.colorSpec: Function-driven green, orange or blue accent with a readable front silhouette.
types.description: 武器、消耗品、工具与装备等可持有物品；细分由能力与展示标签表达

types.name: 机关装置
types.colorSpec: Off-white gray body with blue technical indicators and visible state changes.
types.description: 以触发、控制或改变状态为主要能力的机关装置

types.name: 装饰
types.colorSpec: Low-saturation neutral materials with a clear hard silhouette.
types.description: 仅表现或不承载原生玩法逻辑的装饰素材

types.name: 过渡场景
types.colorSpec: Orange transition accent with clear endpoint-facing entry and exit states.
types.description: 绑定 MapEdge 端点侧的微型过渡场景

perspectiveRules.itemPerspectiveDescription: 眼平直接正交正视图，强调物品清晰剪影与细节
perspectiveRules.spatialPerspectiveDescription: 正面高位斜测轴：顶部与前部可见，固定正交投影
